name: Spear Launcher (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

disable: DC 18 Thievery check on the floor tile or wall socket.

items.name: Spear
items.text: When pressure is applied to the floor tile, the trap shoots a spear, making an attack against the creature or object on the floor tile. The trap makes a ranged Spear attack.

text: A wall socket loaded with a spear connects to a floor tile in one 5-foot square.
